title: Manual subscription
caption: platform.subscriptions with billing_provider = 'manual'. The admin edits plan, trial end and status (Trial, Active, Canceled) with a reason and If-Match; the daily billing.manual_trials (08:10 UTC, only with FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING) moves trials. Stripe-billed rows have no edit form.

states.label: OTA created before M5 / by admin
trialing (Trial)
states.detail: Banner `trial_ending` 14 and 3 days before the end.

states.label: active
states.detail: Paid outside Stripe; go-live accepts it; no trial notice, never past_due.

states.label: past_due
states.detail: Trial ended. After 14 days: canceled and the OTA suspended for `billing`.

states.label: canceled
states.detail: Reopen to Trial/Active refused with `409 current_exists` while another current subscription exists.

transitions.label: daily run on the end day
admin moves the trial end later
daily run, 14 days later (+ suspend billing)
